mapper.select: select t.id as tenant_id, a.id as app_id, t.tenant_code, a.app_code, t.plan_code from tenant t join app a on a.tenant_id = t.id where t.id = #{tenantId} and a.id = #{appId} and t.deleted = false and a.deleted = false limit 1
mapper.update: update tenant set status = 'DELETED', deleted = true, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{tenantId} and deleted = false
update app set status = 'DELETED', deleted = true, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{appId} and deleted = false
